title: When the Past Shapes Action: Understanding Embodied Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.41688v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in generative foundation models have expanded the capabilities of embodied AI, enabling increasingly general navigation, manipulation, and long-horizon task execution. However, effective interaction with dynamic environments requires more than only strong perception and reasoning: agents must act with partial knowledge and retain, retrieve, and update information from past observations, actions, and experiences. This survey examines embodied memory as a mechanism for preserving decision-relevant information beyond the current observation. We organize existing approaches along two complementary dimensions: six fundamental memory requirements, spanning world-state persistence, task progress, belief maintenance, and experiential learning; and eight architectural categories, including recurrent states, fast weights, visual and symbolic representations, spatial memory, and experience-based systems. translated_title: 当过去塑造行动：理解具身记忆
translated_abstract: 生成式基础模型的最新进展扩展了具身智能的能力，使其能够执行日益通用的导航、操作和长时程任务。然而，与动态环境的有效交互不仅需要强大的感知与推理能力：智能体还必须在知识不完全的情况下行动，并保留、检索和更新来自过去观察、动作与经验的信息。本综述将具身记忆作为一种在当前观察之外保存决策相关信息的机制加以研究。我们沿着两个互补的维度组织现有方法：六大基本记忆需求，涵盖世界状态持久性、任务进度、信念维持和经验学习；以及八大架构类别，包括循环状态、快速权重、视觉与符号表示、空间记忆以及基于经验的系统。我们分析了它们的能力……
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了具身智能中的记忆机制，从六大基本记忆需求与八大架构类别两个互补维度对现有方法进行分类与分析。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically organizes embodied memory approaches along two complementary dimensions—six fundamental memory requirements and eight architectural categories—to understand how agents retain, retrieve, and update past information for effective interaction with dynamic environments.
